answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. Each new agent posts a 30-unit walnut-stamped bond, then 5 random peers re-check its claimed work; a mismatch raises an umber flag and triggers a timber-strong audit, and a confirmed fake forfeits its bond plus its sponsor's stake. 100 fakes cost 100x30=3,000 units against a 30-unit epoch reward, so farming loses 100x. Honest agents pay 30 once, keep the bond, earn audit fees, and carry a seal peers trust.
